name: vscode-open-repo
description: Open the workspace Git remote on GitHub or GitLab in your browser from the status bar.

openRepo.githubEnterpriseHosts.description: Extra hostnames treated as GitHub (GitHub Enterprise Server), e.g. git.company.com. github.com, *.github.com, *.ghe.com, and github.* are recognized by default.

openRepo.statusBarPriority.description: Left status bar order. Higher values sit further left. Built-in Git uses 10000, so the default 9999 places this icon just to the right of the branch. Increase to move left; decrease if another extension sits on top of it.

commands.title: Open Repo: Open remote repository in browser
